messages:
Anna (Partnerships): Quick sync: Nvidia Ampere reference architecture + Terraform modules — we need to finalize the module API and marketplace packaging by EOD Wed for the partner submission. Who can own perf numbers and driver matrix?
Raj (Cloud Eng): I can run the driver/ CUDA matrix. Need to confirm supported CUDA >=11.7 and NCCL versions. Also: do we require Ubuntu 22.04 only or support RHEL/CentOS images?
Sophia (DevEx): For the TF module changes: prefer inputs: `region_map`, `instance_types`, `gpu_image_id`. Keep outputs minimal. Avoid provider aliasing in examples so users don't get confused.
Michael (Platform): Testing note: CI should cover 3 regions and at least 2 queue sizes (1 and 16 batch). I'll add a perf job to the infra repo. infra-bot, can you kick a canary with current module branch?
infra-bot: CI pipeline triggered: `partners/nvidia-ampere-modules` branch. Build #482 queued. https://ci.internal/reports/482 :gear:
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks — Sophia, can you paste a minimal usage example we can include in the marketplace listing? Keep it copy-paste friendly.
Sophia (DevEx): Sure. Minimal example below (users copy into main.tf):
```hcl
module "redwood_gpu_pool" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-nvidia-ampere?ref=v0.3.0"

  region_map    = { "us-west-2" = "ami-0abcd1234" }
  instance_types = ["g5.2xlarge", "g5.4xlarge"]
  gpu_image_id  = "ami-0abcd1234"

  min_size = 1
  max_size = 8
}
```
Raj (Cloud Eng): That looks good. Two asks: 1) add `enable_ucx = true` variable defaulted false so customers can enable UCX/NCCL tuning; 2) add an output `gpu_ami` so marketplace can show exact image used.
Sophia (DevEx): Will add both. Also adding a note about kernel/driver compatibility in README: `CUDA 11.7, NVIDIA driver 525+` and a link to the validated matrix.
Anna (Partnerships): For the marketplace listing we need a short diagram and a one-liner for latency/cost targets. Michael, can your team produce an annotated diagram?
Michael (Platform): Yep. I'll drop a PNG into the PR. Also propose we include sample perf numbers: 8k tokens seq, beam=1, p99 latency ~ 220ms on g5.4xlarge. Raj — will your runs confirm or adjust those?
Raj (Cloud Eng): Running perf now across g5.*. Preliminary: g5.4xlarge p99 ~ 210-250ms depending on image and kernel. I'll post a table in the PR.
Anna (Partnerships): Great. Next steps: Sophia updates module API + README, Raj posts perf table and driver matrix, Michael adds diagram and test matrix. We'll aim to merge by Tue EOD to have runway for marketplace review. Any blockers?
Sophia (DevEx): No blockers from my side. I'll open a PR and tag @Raj and @Michael.
Michael (Platform): No blockers.
Raj (Cloud Eng): One small ask — add an env var toggle for telemetry in the module so enterprise customers can opt out.
Sophia (DevEx): Good call — adding `telemetry_enabled = true` default and docs.
Anna (Partnerships): Awesome. I'll start the marketplace submission template once PRs are green. :rocket:
Michael (Platform): LGTM :thumbsup:
Raj (Cloud Eng): I'll update the perf numbers by EOD.
infra-bot: Build #482 started: containers pulled, unit tests running.
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks everyone — filing follow-up with partner PMs after merge.
